title: Sweet Toddler Girl in Bonnet Riding Tricycle, 1950s Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing a sweet African American toddler girl seated on a metal tricycle. She wears a charming light dress, buckle shoes with white socks, and a wide-brimmed sun bonnet tied neatly under her chin. Set in a grassy yard, the image offers a warm and candid glimpse into mid-century African American domestic life and childhood playtime.
